# ScribeCat 0.27.2

- Create task categories with the + next to Categories, including on mobile. Enter the name directly in the category list.
- Create subcategories from the heading icon next to Sort. Type directly in the new heading, and rename or remove it from its own menu. Removing a heading keeps its tasks.
- Fix category drag-and-drop ordering with insertion before or after a category, including horizontal category lists.
- Rename files and folders using the same inline card layout as creation, with Save/Cancel and Enter/Escape.
- Show Trash below the sidebar folders with its icon and label. Permanent deletion uses the app's standard confirmation dialog.
- Move deleted folders and their full contents to Trash. Expand folders to restore individual files or subfolders, or restore the entire folder. Restoring the remainder after a partial restore merges directories without overwriting existing files.
- Keep version histories available for restored files. Deleting the remaining trash contents does not remove the histories of files already restored.

Trash remains in `.scribecat/trash` within the vault and uses the same storage API for local and server vaults. This release does not add automatic expiry.
